notes.title: Major Update 1 is on
notes.notes:
Hello
We have finally released the update. No YouTube plugin yet, we are currently working on adding it and in-game music library.

The update includes:
- Various bug fixes
- Better graphics
- Split-screen multiplayer that can be played online using Steam's Remove Play Together https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687

We are very sorry for the wipe, we had to do that to fix some really serious bug...

notes.title: Legacy version is back!
notes.notes: Right click on Music Racer in your steam library, then choose PROPERTIES, then BETAS, then "Select the beta you would like to opt to", choose LEGACY.

notes.title: Another small update fixing bugs...
notes.notes:
- Bought Parts not saving - fixed
- Not possible to move the camera in the screenshot mode - fixed
- Not possible to color the front lights of the Sting - fixed

notes.title: New content and many other fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
- New YouTube plugin, should be working for some time until Google decides to change the algorithm again
- New car
- New map Greenfield
- New map Modern Retro
- Faster loading
- And much more!

We are aware of some issues with the previous update and so on, but we want to make this game better. Our plans are multiplayer, online matchmaking, profiles, and more content. 

Thank you!
